description: Generic mean-value-engine constants (cards M1-04 onward, R 21.4, P Part 4 Step 1.3). An engine overrides any value with a 'physics' block in configs/engines/<id>.json (same shape). Every value carries provenance; ASSUMED values are generic textbook/installation estimates, never engine ratings or limits (those live in configs/engines). CALIBRATED values are produced at start-up by backend/sim calibration.

manifold_volume_per_displacement.ref: plenum + runners ~1.5x swept volume (MVEM literature, Hendricks & Sorenson SAE 900616)

volumetric_efficiency.ref: tuned intake of a high-revving aero piston engine at rated speed; together with friction it gives an indicated efficiency in the 0.30-0.42 SI range after calibration (tests/sim/test_engine_power.py)

throttle_cd.ref: butterfly discharge coefficient (Heywood, Internal Combustion Engine Fundamentals, ch. 7)

wot_map_ratio.ref: MAP / upstream pressure at wide-open throttle and rated rpm; sets the throttle area (CALIBRATED from it)

idle_area_fraction.ref: closed-throttle leakage + idle bypass as a fraction of full area

filter_dp_kpa_at_rated_flow.ref: clean air filter pressure drop at rated airflow; dp = k * mdot^2

lean_loss_coeff.ref: SI fuel-conversion efficiency falls ~ k (lambda-1.1)^2 beyond the lean optimum (Heywood fig. 15-8 shape)

si_best_lambda.ref: SI efficiency optimum slightly lean of stoichiometric (Heywood ch. 15)

timing_loss_per_deg2.ref: MBT curve: ~4 % torque loss at 10 deg from MBT (Heywood fig. 9-3)

ci_smoke_lambda_min.ref: CI smoke limit lambda ~1.2-1.4 at full load (Heywood ch. 10)

cov_instability_limit_pct.ref: drivability/instability threshold ~5 % COV_IMEP (Heywood ch. 9.4; P Part 4 Step 1.3d)

knock_ref_map_kpa.ref: knock index reference: SL WOT, normal charge temperature

knock_advance_sensitivity_per_deg.ref: knock tendency rise per degree of over-advance (exponential index form)

fmep_a_kpa.ref: FMEP = a + b (N/1000) + c (N/1000)^2 kPa (Chen-Flynn form). Heywood eq. 13.15 automotive values (97/15/5, incl. pumping) give ~23 kW at 5800 rpm on a 1.35 L engine (mechanical efficiency 0.76); reduced to ~0.82 mechanical efficiency at rated, typical of aero engines at WOT

wall_heat_fraction.ref: share of fuel energy to the combustion-chamber walls (Heywood ch. 12: 15-35 %)

head_to_coolant_fraction.ref: share of wall heat leaving through the coolant (liquid-cooled heads); the rest via barrel fins to cooling air

oil_fuel_heat_fraction.ref: share of fuel energy rejected to the oil (piston cooling, Heywood ch. 12)

oil_friction_heat_fraction.ref: share of friction power ending up in the oil

exhaust_cp_j_kgk.ref: exhaust gas specific heat at 800-900 C

calibration_isa_dev_c.ref: R 21.5 step 4: cooling calibrated at max continuous, ISA+15, design airspeed

target_coolant_c.ref: normal coolant operating temperature at max continuous (inside every engine's limits)

target_head_minus_coolant_c.ref: head runs above coolant exit temperature

target_oil_c.ref: normal oil temperature (inside the 90-110 C normal band where the OM gives one)

target_gearbox_c.ref: gearbox oil temperature at max continuous

tau_head_s.ref: cylinder head thermal time constant (minutes-scale CHT response, T-PHY-9)

oil_thermostat_open_c.ref: installation oil-cooler thermostat starts opening (Rotax installations commonly fit one)

oil_thermostat_full_c.ref: oil-cooler thermostat fully open (below the 100 C calibration target, so calibration is unaffected)

coolant_thermostat_open_c.ref: coolant thermostat / radiator bypass starts opening

coolant_thermostat_full_c.ref: coolant thermostat fully open (below the 90 C calibration target)

vogel_a_mpas.ref: Vogel mu = a exp(b/(T + c)), T in C; SAE 30-class constants (Seeton 2006 fit form)

relief_bar.ref: relief valve cracks at the top of the 2-5 bar normal band (R 21.5 step 5)

calibration_rpm_fraction.ref: pump calibrated at 60 % of rated rpm with hot oil

calibration_pressure_bar.ref: oil pressure at the calibration point (inside the normal band)

low_pressure_friction_gain.ref: boundary lubrication: bearing friction x (1 + gain * deficit^2) below the minimum pressure (seizure chain, R 21.4)

firing_order_mm_s_at_rated.ref: firing-order velocity at rated torque on the gearbox sensor (legacy nominal VIB_GEARBOX_RMS ~0.48 mm/s)

manufacturing_spread.ref: cylinder-to-cylinder torque spread of a healthy engine (sets the 0.5/1st order floor)

gear_mesh_mm_s_at_rated.ref: gear-mesh order of a healthy reduction gearbox at rated torque

prop_imbalance_gain.ref: F28: prop 1x multiplier at full severity

gear_damage_gain.ref: F27: gear-mesh multiplier at full severity

mount_gain.ref: F29: transmissibility multiplier of all orders at full severity

low_order_gain.ref: soft engine mounts put rigid-body modes near the 0.5/1st order at cruise rpm, so low orders reach the sensor strongly amplified relative to the firing order (raised from 4 after T-FLT-1: a misfire on Rotax-class engines is felt as a strong low-order shake)

compressor_efficiency.ref: small automotive/aero turbocharger compressor isentropic efficiency

intercooler_effectiveness.ref: air-to-air intercooler effectiveness (only when configs/engines turbo.intercooled)

no_boost_pressure_ratio.ref: pressure ratio left when the wastegate is stuck open (F15): the compressor windmills

bearing_pr_loss.ref: F17: share of the available pressure ratio margin lost at full bearing wear

bearing_lag_gain.ref: F17: spool time constant multiplier at full bearing wear

rail_time_constant_s.ref: common-rail pressure response to the pump/regulator (R 21.4 rail dynamics)

pulse_width_max_factor.ref: ECU can stretch injection pulse width to 130 % of nominal to compensate low rail pressure (F09)

si_fuel_pressure_bar.ref: port-injection fuel pressure nominal (912 i OM band 2.8-3.2 bar; 915 assumed same family)

ci_supply_pressure_bar.ref: diesel low-pressure supply at the HP pump inlet (AE300 TCDS band 4-7 bar)

lane_loss_ignition_energy.ref: SI dual ignition: one circuit lost halves ignition energy (slower burn) (R 22 F04)

lane_loss_timing_error_deg.ref: single-plug burn is slower: effective phasing error after a lane loss

overspeed_fuel_cut_margin.ref: fuel cut above overspeed (or rated) rpm x (1 + margin)

knock_retard_deg_per_index.ref: knock control retards ignition 10 deg per unit of knock index above 1 (F03 shows as timing retard)

torque_lag_na_s.ref: torque response of a naturally aspirated engine (fuel transport + manifold)

starter_torque_nm.ref: starter torque at the crankshaft while cranking

run_rpm_fraction_of_idle.ref: engine counts as running above this fraction of idle rpm

glow_preheat_s.ref: CI cold start: glow plugs must preheat this long below 20 C coolant before fuel is admitted

seize_time_s.ref: seizure after oil pressure stays below its minimum for this long at load (R 21.4 t_seize)

overheat_margin.ref: overheat failure above warning limit x (1 + margin)

fuel_starvation_fraction.ref: fuel delivery below this share of demand = starvation

burn_duration_deg_per_unit.ref: a burn 100 % longer acts like ~20 deg of combustion phasing error (F06 slower burn)

cycle_variation_quality_loss.ref: mean work lost per unit of extra cycle-to-cycle variation (F02: mostly variance, little mean)

injector_leak_rail_loss.ref: rail pressure share lost per unit of leak-off (F07 on common rail)

exhaust_leak_egt_drop.ref: EGT reading drop at full leak (air ingress upstream of the probe, F31)

exhaust_leak_boost_loss.ref: boost share lost per cylinder exhaust leak on turbo engines (F31)

gear_damage_loss_gain.ref: gear losses multiply by 1 + gain x damage (F27 heats the gearbox)

bearing_clearance_exponent.ref: oil pressure falls ~ clearance^-1.5 (bearing leakage, F26)

oil_starvation_fraction.ref: below this share of oil capacity the pump starts to starve (F24)

knock_vibration_mm_s_per_index.ref: high-frequency knock vibration per unit of knock index above 1 (F03)

turbo_sync_mm_s.ref: turbo-synchronous vibration of a healthy turbo

turbo_sync_bearing_gain.ref: turbo-synchronous vibration multiplier at full bearing wear (F17)

glow_cold_quality.ref: combustion quality of a cylinder with a failed glow plug while the coolant is below glow_warm_c (F35)

glow_warm_c.ref: coolant temperature above which a failed glow plug no longer matters

cycle_variation_vibration_mm_s.ref: 0.5X added per unit of extra cycle-to-cycle variation (F02: irregular torque pulses)

turbo_bearing_oil_heat_w.ref: extra heat into the oil at full turbo bearing wear (F17)

knock_wall_heat_gain.ref: wall heat fraction rises 30 % per unit of knock index above 1 (knock scrubs the thermal boundary layer, F03)

noise_temperature_c.ref: thermocouple / RTD noise (1 sigma) for CHT, EGT, oil, coolant, gearbox, charge temperatures

noise_pressure_rel.ref: pressure transducer noise as a share of reading (oil, fuel, MAP)

noise_flow_rel.ref: fuel-flow meter noise as a share of reading

noise_electrical_rel.ref: voltage / current measurement noise as a share of reading

noise_gain_s04.ref: S04: noise multiplier at full severity

bias_rel_s02.ref: S02: bias at full severity as a share of the channel's normal value

drift_rel_per_min_s03.ref: S03: drift rate at full severity, share of normal value per minute (R 22: demo-visible, 1-3 C/min on CHT)

lane_split_rel_s07.ref: S07: lane B disagreement at full severity

out_of_range_factor_s06.ref: S06: short/open circuit reads this multiple of the normal value

volumetric_efficiency.ref: volumetric efficiency: build-to-build manufacturing spread (1 sigma, relative), sampled once per tail seed; carried over from the retired backend/plant/virtual_engine.py EngineVariation (D31: N calibrations, not N detectors)

friction.ref: friction mean effective pressure: build-to-build manufacturing spread (1 sigma, relative), sampled once per tail seed; carried over from the retired backend/plant/virtual_engine.py EngineVariation (D31: N calibrations, not N detectors)

head_cooling.ref: per-cylinder head heat-transfer conductances (to coolant and to air): build-to-build manufacturing spread (1 sigma, relative), sampled once per tail seed; carried over from the retired backend/plant/virtual_engine.py EngineVariation (D31: N calibrations, not N detectors)

injector_trim.ref: per-cylinder injector / jet flow: build-to-build manufacturing spread (1 sigma, relative), sampled once per tail seed; carried over from the retired backend/plant/virtual_engine.py EngineVariation (D31: N calibrations, not N detectors)

compressor_efficiency.ref: turbo compressor efficiency: build-to-build manufacturing spread (1 sigma, relative), sampled once per tail seed; carried over from the retired backend/plant/virtual_engine.py EngineVariation (D31: N calibrations, not N detectors)

rpm_fraction_min.ref: lowest map rpm as a share of rated rpm (performance-map grid, P 1.3q)

rpm_points.ref: rpm grid points from the minimum to rated rpm

load_step_pct.ref: throttle (spark ignition) or power-lever (diesel) step of the map grid
